title: Reverse Integer
description:
You are given an integer x.

Reverse its digits and return the result.

Important Rules
If x is negative → keep the sign
Remove leading zeros after reversing
Example: 120 → 21
If the reversed number goes outside 32-bit signed range:
[-2^31, 2^31 - 1]

→ return 0
input_format: A single line containing the integer x.
output_format: Print a single integer representing the reversed value (or 0 if it overflows).
